caption:
The mountain sets the pace; you decide whether to argue. When the gradient tilts upward and the gravel turns loose, the only thing that matters is the rhythm of your own breath against the quiet of the forest. There are no crowds here to carry you, no engines to mask the sound of your tires. Just the climb, the weight of the air, and the steady work of finding your own way through the canopy.
